751-3755-4460.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2103-2455-2707.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

4770-5295-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-4186-4779-6689-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Golbez triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-7435--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-3110-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-4863.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-4863.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1267-2349-7712.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn with {2}{W}{U} each extra turn
1267-2349-7712.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast The Wondrous Wasp by paying {1}{U}.
When The Wondrous Wasp enters, it triggers, tapping Medomai and causing it to lose all its abilities until The Wondrous Wasp leaves the battlefield.
Move to your next turn.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Mistmeadow Witch by paying {2}{W}{U}, exiling The Wondrous Wasp until your end step. This will also cause Medomai to regain its abilities.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Mistmeadow Witch triggers, returning The Wondrous Wasp from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2654-2806.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon
1618-2440-2654-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2654-2806.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

851-1169-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

803-3967-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-3967-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2341-2495-4851.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Timeless Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Timeless Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Timeless Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

3750-7019-7025.easyPrerequisites: You and an opponent each control a creature.
3750-7019-7025.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-7019-7025.description:
Cast The Last Agni Kai by paying {1}{R}.
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering Avatar Roku, adding six {R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to The Last Agni Kai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
3750-7019-7025.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Avatar Roku infinitely to give your red creatures infinite power. You can use the same creature to fight in step 1 and attack if the creature will not die.

877-4415-6986.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {0}.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2842-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1456-1987-4131-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Basalt Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Basalt Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

719-4508-5880-6291.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1874-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1874-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

813-3378-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Illusionist's Stratagem.
813-3378-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1496-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1496-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1025-6286.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonland permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1025-6286.description:
During your upkeep, Stasis triggers.
Holding priority, activate a nonland permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
At the beginning of your endstep, Unstoppable Plan triggers, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
While Stasis is on the battlefield, players will skip their untap steps.

2196-2821-5803-6256.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-5803-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Muraganda Raceway and another land.
Activate Muraganda Raceway and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

1379-3401-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
1379-3401-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1379-3401-5803.description:
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 3.

293-2921-5220-5716.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1339-3284-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3284-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

250-779-2657.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Gitrog triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat.

1486-4644-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-4644-4875.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
